title: Profile manifest
description: profile.json at the root of a profiles/<id>/ directory. Supplies the classification globs, artifact rule set, and namespaced kinds a profile adds on top of the core.

classification.description: Merged into classify_targets.py's built-in core globs when this profile is selected.

artifact_rules.description: Paths (relative to the profile directory) to the profile's artifact rule files. This is what references/rules/rules-generator-quality-control.md consumes instead of a hardcoded reference, decoupling the generic generator-contradiction/gap framework from any one profile's artifact vocabulary.

kinds.description: Namespaced kinds this profile may emit, e.g. 'aplicatudo-e2e/artifact'. Must use the profile's own id as namespace.

evals_path.description: Path (relative to the profile directory) to this profile's evals.json.
